title: Reliable Annotations with Less Effort: Evaluating LLM-Human Collaboration in Search Clarifications

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing confusion matrices and class-wise prediction distributions to identify systematic misclassifications and the tendency of models to disproportionately favor specific rating classes (e.g., middle or extreme labels) over others.

Classifying queries into specific topic domains (e.g., Technical Topics, Entertainment, Legal) to analyze whether model confidence, performance, and prediction consistency vary systematically across different subject areas.
